mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 60 degrees near the Verona Public Library, all under the glow of a full moon.

The city is launching a rain barrel rebate program where you can earn a 30 dollar credit on your utility bill for installing qualifying barrels. Additionally, the intersection at Nine Mound Road and Mark Drive will be closed from August 5 through August 7 for construction.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, or Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow features music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, while the weekend brings the Dane County Farmers' Market and music at Paddy Mac's.
In a look at the weekly report, officers arrested a 23-year-old man on Wednesday, July 23, following a domestic disturbance call on Lucerne Drive.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Turtle. The store is currently closed, but they will be opening their doors at 10:00 AM today for you to get your fix.
